redRegressions.before: Restart reset messagesThisTick to zero and admitted a second message with a configured per-tick budget of one.
redRegressions.after: Restore derives usage from committed current-tick send evidence; duplicate retries do not spend extra budget.

redRegressions.before: Restore accepted a COMPLETED contract with only an offer message/event.
redRegressions.after: Messages and expiration deadlines must reproduce the exact event sequence, final states and deduplication evidence.

legacyFixture.origin: Exported from verified 4411675 shaded JAR before radio transaction changes.
legacyFixture.resumedOutcome: Original offer/accept are not repeated; pending 1-unit fulfillment then a new 2-unit fulfillment complete the 3-unit contract. Four contract events and eight radio events persist.

failureMatrix: Send save failure preserves exact memory/disk state, endpoints and message budget; close cannot commit the failed send.
Ack save failure preserves the original envelope across disconnect, restart and retry.
Inbox batch failure preserves every receipt, contract transition and ack; retry commits valid messages once while retaining invalid ones.
Fulfillment/ack save failure preserves ACCEPTED state and pending delivery; restart retry completes once.
Expiration save failure preserves both clocks and OFFERED state; retry publishes one EXPIRED event.
20-tick checkpoint save failure retains the preceding tick and can retry without stopping radio.
Close flush failure is retryable; successful repeated close is idempotent.
Restored current-tick budget and mailbox capacity reject extra sends; ack releases mailbox capacity.
Unknown/null/duplicate snapshots, forged history, missing/reordered events and orphaned contract receipts are rejected.
limitations: No new Paper/Folia client or human communication acceptance run; scheduling and long-duration server capacity remain to validate.
No wire/schema version changes. Valid v1 state is compatible; contradictory snapshots previously accepted are now rejected without repair.
Ordinary logical time still checkpoints every 20 ticks; process termination can rewind idle time to the last durable checkpoint. Contract expirations save immediately.
All contracts remain simulation-only and never settle real assets.
Memory-constrained non-forked unit runs and ephemeral signer keys do not establish production performance or official release signing.
The P0-P11 objective remains active and phase gates retain their documented incomplete status.
